summary: Linn County, OR cabin site: a 1936 cabin, a 1950 L-4 cabin, removed or destroyed in 1960; a social media post reports footings still on the ridge.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed in 1960 per the register and Forest Lookouts (destroyed per firelookout.com); an undated social media post reports footings still on the ridge

access.note: On Willamette National Forest land; no source read describes a road, trail, or closure

events.note: First cabin on the ridge; the register, firelookout.com and a Facebook post all date it to 1936
Panorama photograph taken; the register caption credits the National Archives Pacific Northwest Region
New cabin built one-fourth mile above Detroit Reservoir; Forest Lookouts calls it an L-4 cabin
Register and Forest Lookouts say removed; firelookout.com says destroyed
Registered May 8, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: first cabin in 1936; new cabin built in 1950 one-fourth mile above Detroit Reservoir; removed in 1960
evidence.quote: Starting with a cabin in 1936, a new cabin was built in 1950 one-fourth mile above Detroit Reservoir and was removed in 1960.

evidence.supports: firelookout.com lists cabins in 1936 and 1950 and says destroyed in 1960
location Linn County, Oregon, in the Willamette National Forest
photograph panoramic 1937, courtesy of National Archives Pacific Northwest Region
evidence.quote: Kinney Ridge Lookout panoramic 6-4-1937 - courtesy of National Archives-Pacific Northwest Region

evidence.supports: 1950 cabin was an L-4 lookout cabin
Forest Lookouts records the lookout removed in 1960
administered by the U.S. Forest Service
Facebook post dates the cabin to 1936 and its removal to 1960
evidence.quote: Kinney Ridge Lookout was built in 1936, and removed in 1960.

evidence.supports: footings and a folding chair still on the ridge, per the post
evidence.quote: It was nifty to find the old footings and an old folding chair still up there.

evidence.supports: location: Willamette National Forest (the register's Location field)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Forest Lookouts say the cabin was removed in 1960; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1960. The story reports both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: The brief's record matches the sources; no corrections proposed. Sources disagree on removed vs destroyed in 1960 and the story says so. The only description of the site today is an undated Facebook post by The Oregon Challenge; treat it as a single informal report. The brief's access value (unknown) is kept because no source describes access. The 1936 cabin is described as a cabin, not a tower; the brief's kind 'ground' is consistent. No photo URLs were found, so none are listed.
